blocks.text: INDIAN WELLS, California— Katerina Siniakova has clinched her record sixth year-end finish as the world’s top-ranked doubles player on the WTA Tour. She will have held the top spot for 209 weeks as of Monday, leaving her second all-time behind Hall of Famer and fellow Czech Republic native Martina Navratilova, who was No. 1 for 237 weeks. Siniakova has a 54-8 match record this year, including titles at the French and U.S. opens with Taylor Townsend. She’s won a Tour-leading seven doubles titles, five with Townsend and two with Zhang Shuai. Siniakova won four WTA 1000 tournaments, including the Sunshine Double […]...
